title: A Wildheart first-night block with no link shows no dead button

source.ref: Unwired-things scan 2026-11-18 (project thread: Verify every feature path end to end); owner: full approval to make it all right

detail:
On Space websites using the Wildheart theme, the Your first night block showed its Save my place button even when the block had no link, as a button with no handler: a visitor picked an option, the button appeared, and clicking it did nothing. Now the button renders only when the block has a link.

DONE 2026-11-18.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
